prompt: a young adult East Asian woman sitting in a minimalist light-colored indoor space, captured from head to near thighs. The subject is slightly right of center, body angled slightly to the left, upper body leaning forward naturally with relaxed shoulders. Hands are softly folded in front, one hand holding the opposite wrist in a quiet, relaxed, and elegant pose. Head tilted slightly down and turned to the left, gaze directed into the distance, not looking at the camera, expression calm, gentle, and restrained, lips naturally closed. She has a delicate and soft oval face, a clear but not overly sharp jawline, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender nose bridge, and low-saturation nude-rose lips. Makeup is extremely light, keeping only a thin base, natural lashes, fine eyeliner, and a slight warm blush. Skin tone is warm white to natural, preserving real pores, fine downy hair, slight skin tone variations, and soft sebum highlights; no plastic-style airbrushing. Long dark brown-black hair flows naturally with soft large waves and a real sense of weight, most of it falling over the front of the left shoulder and chest, voluminous hair with stray strands, natural messiness, and a soft sheen. She is wearing a light champagne, cream beige, or pale oatmeal silk robe in a loose dropped-shoulder design, the neckline naturally slipping off one shoulder to reveal the collarbone and neck. The fabric is soft matte silk or fine satin with real wrinkles, drape, and low-key reflections; loose sleeves, the hem naturally spreading over the legs and floor, overall subtle, pure, and airy. Background is a cream-white or light gray-white minimalist interior without obvious furniture, only soft walls, a light floor, and slightly blurred horizontal lines in the distance. Strong but soft natural window light enters from both the back-right and front-left, creating high-key diffuse lighting, hair rim lighting, and highlights on the neck and silk. Shadows are very shallow, overall low saturation and low contrast, dominated by cream-white, champagne, warm skin tones, and dark brown hair. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, eye-level slightly high angle, shallow depth of field, eyes and face clear, background creamy bokeh, real skin, hair, and silk fiber textures, slight ISO 200 film grain, Kodak Portra 160 color profile, soft fine-art editorial portrait, photorealistic. Avoid: looking at camera, exaggerated expressions, heavy makeup, plastic skin, over-smoothing, transparent clothing, exaggerated body proportions, incorrect fingers, deformed arms, high HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered background, CG, anime, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh: 一位年轻的东亚女性 坐在极简主义的浅色室内空间中，取景范围从头部到大腿附近。主体位于画面中心偏右，身体略微向左倾斜，上半身自然前倾，肩膀放松。双手在身前轻柔交叠，一只手握住另一只手的手腕，姿态安静、放松且优雅。头部微微下垂并转向左侧，目光投向远方，不看镜头，表情平静、温柔且内敛，双唇自然闭合。她拥有精致柔和的鹅蛋脸，下颌线清晰但不锐利，杏仁状的深褐色眼睛，自然的细眉，鼻梁挺拔，低饱和度的裸粉色双唇。妆容极淡，仅保留轻薄底妆、自然睫毛、细眼线和淡淡的暖色腮红。肤色为暖白色至自然色，保留了真实的毛孔、细小的绒毛、细微的肤色差异以及柔和的皮脂光泽；无塑料感的磨皮效果。深褐黑色长发自然垂落，带有柔和的大波浪和真实的垂坠感，大部分发丝垂在左肩前和胸前，发量丰盈，带有几缕碎发、自然的凌乱感和柔和的光泽。她身穿一件 浅香槟色、奶油米色或淡燕麦色的丝绸长袍，采用宽松的落肩设计，领口自然滑落露出锁骨和颈部。面料为柔软的哑光丝绸或精细缎面，带有真实的褶皱、垂坠感和低调的反光；袖口宽松，下摆自然铺散在腿部和地面上，整体风格含蓄、纯净且空灵。背景为奶油白或浅灰白色的极简主义室内空间，没有明显的家具，只有柔和的墙面、浅色地板以及远处略显模糊的水平线条。强烈但柔和的自然窗光从右后方和左前方射入，营造出高调的漫射光、发丝轮廓光以及颈部和丝绸上的高光。阴影非常浅，整体低饱和度、低对比度，以奶油白、香槟色、暖肤色和深褐色头发为主色调。摄影风格：85mm 人像镜头，f/1.8，平视略微俯拍视角，浅景深，眼睛和面部清晰，背景呈现奶油般的虚化效果，真实的皮肤、头发和丝绸纤维纹理，轻微的 ISO 200 胶片颗粒感，Kodak Portra 160 色彩配置，柔和的艺术时尚肖像，照片级真实感。避免：看镜头、夸张的表情、浓妆、塑料感皮肤、过度磨皮、透明服装、夸张的身体比例、手指错误、手臂畸形、高 HDR、过度锐化、杂乱的背景、CG、动漫、文字、水印、Logo。
